rows.organisme: Kenchikushi system (建築士) — MLIT state licence; central register of first-class holders kept by the federation of kenchikushi associations (designated central body)

alternatives.nom: 日本建築士会連合会 (fédération des kenchikushi-kai préfectoraux)

rows.notes: 383,923 一級建築士 (first class) on the register as at 1 April 2025 (official PDF verified). MAJOR PITFALL: this is cumulative stock, not practising professionals — the title covers architects AND building engineers and includes the retired and the inactive (~44% were aged 60 or over in 2024); only ~38% are attached to a practice. There are also 796,459 second-class (prefectural) holders and 19,124 “timber” holders: ~1.2 M kenchikushi in all. The register can only be consulted in person. Do not equate kenchikushi with “architect” in the UIA sense.

rows.organisme: MOHURD — registered first-class architects (一级注册建筑师), national registration committee

alternatives.nom: Architectural Society of China (ASC, section UIA)

rows.notes: 51,374 first-class architects in 2025 (MOHURD registration centre via a specialist journal, URL verified); 30,863 in 2020 (+66%). Two tiers (national/provincial). The official 四库一平台 register (jzsc.mohurd.gov.cn) is unreachable from outside China — URL not supplied. Design work goes mainly through qualified design institutes; individual registration serves the signature right.

rows.organisme: 건축사 state licence (MOLIT examination) — registration with KARB, operated by the Korea Institute of Registered Architects (대한건축사협회)
rows.notes: 17,472 건축사 in 2025 against 12,462 in 2021 (+40%) — press citing KIRA data (verified); ~1,000-1,100 successful candidates a year. KIRA membership has become COMPULSORY again (reform passed January 2022). KARB: publicly searchable. MOLIT publishes 건축사현황 in XLSX every year (statistical portal verified). UIA: through the FIKA federation.

rows.organisme: 建築師 state licence (national examination) + compulsory membership of a local order federated by the National Architects Association

alternatives.nom: 中華民國全國建築師公會 (NAA, fédère 18 ordres locaux)

rows.notes: 建築師法 regime: examination, certificate, then a practice-opening licence and compulsory membership of the local 公會. No verifiable national headcount found (the building portal is inaccessible from outside Taiwan; the Ministry of the Interior's statistical yearbook publishes 建築師開業人數 but could not be consulted). UIA: “Chinese Taipei Association of Architects”; not an ARCASIA member.

rows.organisme: Architects Registration Board (Cap. 408)
rows.notes: 4,526 = count of the online ARB register (452 pages × 10 + 6, on 5 August 2026) — no total is displayed. Cap. 408 protects the title “Registered Architect”; plan submission goes through the separate Authorized Person regime (List I). The HKIA publishes a nominal list of its members as a PDF (verified, 10 June 2026: 4,295) — that is the association, not the register.

rows.organisme: Conselho de Arquitectura, Engenharia e Urbanismo (Law No. 1/2015)

alternatives.nom: Architects Association of Macau (AAM, section UIA)

rows.notes: Law 1/2015: recognition of qualifications and registration are handled by the CAEU — the site is live but no public list and no headcount are reachable from outside; the lists appear in the Official Gazette.

rows.organisme: Union of Mongolian Architects — association; design-activity licences from the Ministry of Construction
rows.notes: No public register of architects found. Regulation works through activity licences (design firms) rather than an individual register. ARCASIA: UMA is a member.

rows.organisme: Board of Architects (Architects Act 1991)
rows.notes: EXEMPLARY CASE: the BOA register is open data on data.gov.sg (nominal CSV: name, number, practice; 1,999 records counted via the API on 5 August 2026, current as at 13 July 2026) = holders of a practising certificate. Companion datasets: practices and foreign architects. The Architects Act reserves architectural services to registrants. The SIA is ABSENT from the list of UIA sections (verified).

rows.organisme: Lembaga Arkitek Malaysia / Board of Architects Malaysia (Architects Act 1967)
rows.notes: 2,663 “Arkitek Profesional” counted on 5 August 2026: the COMPLETE nominal list is served on a single HTML page — de facto downloadable in bulk (grade A despite the absence of a CSV). The site requires a browser User-Agent (Cloudflare). LAM also registers Graduate Architects, technologists and others. UIA: PAM. Confirmed by direct count on 5 August 2026: 2,663 exactly (No 1-2663 unbroken; 2,661 distinct number-name pairs, two printing duplicates kept and flagged); sister role “Graduate Architect” seen on the portal, not harvested. Sister role harvested on 5 August 2026: 2,821 Registered Graduate Architects (No 1-2821 unbroken, double-checked) in the corpus annexe — the waiting room: 2,821 graduates for 2,663 Arkitek Profesional on the same day.

rows.organisme: Architect Council of Thailand (สภาสถาปนิก), Architect Act B.E. 2543 (2000)

alternatives.nom: Association of Siamese Architects (ASA) — 11 372 membres en règle

rows.notes: The ACT licenses 4 fields across 3 grades. No public TOTAL found: the official annual reports (PDFs verified) do not publish the headcount; the former online verification tool is dead (404). The ASA displays 11,372 members in good standing (member-stat page) — that is the association, not the council. UIA: ASA.

rows.organisme: Practice certificates (chứng chỉ hành nghề kiến trúc) issued by the provincial Departments of Construction — Architecture Law No. 40/2019/QH14

alternatives.nom: Hội Kiến trúc sư Việt Nam (VAA, fondée 1948) — ~6 000 membres (2015)

rows.notes: Issued at PROVINCIAL level (Sở Xây dựng), with examinations entrusted to the socio-professional organisations (including the VAA); no national total published, and the national portal was unreachable when tested. UIA: Vietnamese section.

rows.organisme: Professional Regulation Commission — Board of Architecture (RA 9266 of 2004)

alternatives.nom: United Architects of the Philippines (UAP) — IAPOA accréditée

rows.notes: 58,000 = headcount claimed by the UAP (2024); as the UAP is the compulsory integrated organisation, this is a good proxy for the PRC total — the exact PRC figure is released only on FOI request. Name-by-name verification online (verification.prc.gov.ph). Strong flow: 2,799 candidates passed the June 2026 examination (85%). The UAP's former domain is lost (it redirects to a third-party site).

rows.organisme: Dewan Arsitek Indonesia — STRA national register (Law UU 6/2017)
rows.notes: Recently established: 2017 law, DAI installed on 3 December 2020, STRA since 2021. 4,400 architects holding an STRA in February 2024 (Kompas, verified — a ratio of 1 per 80,000 inhabitants) against 26,000 IAI members: the gap = a transition still under way. Direktori STRA is public (verified). Beware the name clash: dai.or.id = the insurance council.

rows.organisme: Myanmar Architect Council (Law No. 39/2014)
rows.notes: The MAC publishes lists by category (RA, LA, SLA, ASEAN Architect) — URLs verified. PITFALL: the lists are published as IMAGE GALLERIES (WordPress): they can be viewed but neither searched nor counted automatically; no aggregate total.

rows.organisme: Board of Architects Cambodia
rows.notes: The BAC (under the Ministry of Land Management) is reported, but bac.org.kh was unreachable when tested; the law has not been verified in a primary source — no figure supplied.

rows.organisme: Association of Lao Architects and Civil Engineers (no separate professional order; oversight by the MPWT)
rows.notes: No public register and no headcount. The ALACE brings together architects AND civil engineers — do not take its headcount for a count of architects. Company licences through the MPWT.

rows.organisme: Board of Architects, Professional Engineers and Quantity Surveyors (Ministry of Development)
rows.notes: BAPEQS confirmed (the mod.gov.bn/bapeqs page is reduced to a banner); legal basis cited: Order 2011 — to be confirmed. The former lists of Registered Architects are no longer accessible.

rows.organisme: No registration body identified
rows.notes: No professional order, board or national association found; neither ARCASIA nor UIA. A tiny market, with professionals often registered abroad.

rows.organisme: Registration by state/territory: 8 boards (NSW ARB, ARBV…); standards and aggregation by the Architects Accreditation Council of Australia
rows.notes: NO consolidated national register: the AACA “Industry Profile” (February 2018, verified) = 13,567 cumulative registrations at the end of 2017, i.e. ~11,800 UNIQUE architects (cross-state double registrations ~13%) — “~14,000” circulates for recent years with no up-to-date official source (the AACA 2024-25 annual report does not publish one). State registers are searchable (NSW verified). UIA: AIA.

rows.organisme: New Zealand Registered Architects Board (Registered Architects Act 2005)

alternatives.nom: Te Kāhui Whaihanga New Zealand Institute of Architects (NZIA)

rows.notes: The NZRAB site displays “Registered (2436)” live, plus 238 in voluntary suspension (5 August 2026) — the register is searchable and broken down by region. Only the TITLE is protected: design work is not reserved (hence registration is not compulsory). UIA: NZIA.

rows.organisme: Papua New Guinea Institute of Architects (statutory registration regime reported)
rows.notes: A registration regime (late 1980s) is reported but has not been verified online; no active official site and no public register. Headcount unknown — probably a few dozen.

rows.organisme: Fiji Association of Architects (regime reported under the Architects Act, Cap. 268)
rows.notes: The Architects Act (Cap. 268) is reported but has not been verified in a primary source; no active site and no public register. Headcount unknown — a few dozen.
